latest_release.name: v3.2.0
latest_release.body:
## 更新内容

- 后台页面可使用图片或视频壁纸，并可单独切换毛玻璃效果。默认保留原有后台外观。
- 登录页只加载所需样式，在线壁纸在后台刷新。图片源不可用时，自动回到上传的本地图片或视频。
- 改善小屏无线详情、侧栏键盘导航、强制颜色模式和自定义主题色的文字对比度。升级后浏览器会获取新版主题脚本和样式。
- Unsplash 与 Wallhaven 分别保存密钥。原先使用 Unsplash 的配置会自动迁移。归属不明的旧密钥保留在本地 `legacy_wallpaper_api_key`，Wallhaven 标签源使用 `wallhaven_api_key`。

## What changed

- Use image or video wallpapers on admin pages and toggle the glass effect independently. Existing admin layouts keep their default appearance.
- Load only the styles needed for sign-in and refresh online wallpapers in the background. Failed image requests fall back to an uploaded image or video.
- Improve narrow-screen wireless details, keyboard navigation, forced colors and text contrast with custom theme colors. Browsers refresh Argon scripts and styles after upgrades.
- Store Unsplash and Wallhaven keys separately. Existing Unsplash configurations migrate automatically. Unassigned keys stay local in `legacy_wallpaper_api_key`. Tagged Wallhaven sources use `wallhaven_api_key`.

从 v3.1.0 及以上版本，可在 **系统 → Argon 主题设置 → 主题更新** 中检查并安装本版。

From v3.1.0 or later, open **System → Argon Config → Theme updates** to check for and install this release.

[中文安装说明](https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon/blob/v3.2.0/README_ZH.md#安装) · [English installation guide](https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon/blob/v3.2.0/README.md#install)


## What's Changed
* feat(ui): background image by @Sn0wo2 in https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon/pull/744

## New Contributors
* @Sn0wo2 made their first contribution in https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon/pull/744

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon/compare/v3.1.4...v3.2.0

# A brand new OpenWrt LuCI theme · v3 Argon is **a clean and tidy OpenWrt LuCI theme** that allows
users to customize their login interface with images or videos. It also supports automatic and manual switching between light and dark modes. [![license][license-badge]][license] [![prs][prs-badge]][prs] [![issues][issues-badge]][issues] [![release][release-badge]][release] [![download][download-badge]][download] [![contact][contact-badge]][contact] **English** · [简体中文](README_ZH.md) [![Argon 3.0 desktop demo: two login layouts, light and dark modes, and built-in settings](Screenshots/argon-3-demo.gif)](Screenshots/argon-3-demo.mp4) [Watch the desktop demo · MP4](Screenshots/argon-3-demo.mp4)
## What's new in 3.2 - Admin pages can use a local or online wallpaper. The glass effect has its own switch. - Sign-in loads a smaller stylesheet. Online wallpapers refresh in the background and fall back to your local media if the image fails. - Keyboard navigation, high-contrast controls and wireless details work better on small screens. From v3.1.0 or later, open **System → Argon Config → Theme updates**, select **Check for updates**, then **Update now**. On v3.0.0 or earlier, install v3.2.0 manually once to enable future online updates. See the [release notes](RELEASE.md). ## 3.0 highlights - **Built-in Argon Config.** Manage the theme without a separate plugin. - **Broad third-party app support.** Refined layouts, forms and tables for most third-party LuCI apps, with desktop/mobile and light/dark adaptations. - **Two login layouts.** Choose the classic sidebar or centered card. - **Light and dark.** Switch from the header or follow your system, with customizable accent colors. - **Your own look.** Adjust login glass effects, set image or video backgrounds, and upload a browser icon and login logo. - **Desktop and mobile.** Responsive layouts across screen sizes. ## Install **In 3.0, the theme and configuration features are one package: `luci-theme-argon`. Fresh installations need only this package.** Download the format matching your firmware's native package manager from [Releases](https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon/releases). If the old standalone configuration plugin is installed, follow the migration steps below first. | Package manager | Package | Install | | --- | --- | --- | | `opkg` | `.ipk` | `opkg install ./luci-theme-argon_*.ipk` | | APK v3 (`apk-tools 3.x`) | `.apk` | `apk add --allow-untrusted ./luci-theme-argon-*.apk` | Run `opkg update` or `apk update` first. APK v2 cannot read these APK packages; keep your firmware's native package manager. For translations, install the matching `luci-i18n-argon-config-` package from the same release and in the same format. Select **Argon** under **System → System → Language and Style → Design**.
Already have the old luci-app-argon-config? Migrate to 3.0 This applies only when the old standalone configuration plugin is installed. Otherwise, skip this section. The settings page, colors, backgrounds and branding are all included in the theme. The release's `luci-app-argon-config` is an **empty migration package using the old package name**. It preserves existing settings and hands its files over to the theme. 1. Download both `luci-app-argon-config` and `luci-theme-argon` from the **same release in the theme repository**, in the same format. 2. Put both files in one directory on the router and open a terminal there. **Do not uninstall the old plugin first.** Choose the command pair for your firmware; run the second command only after the first succeeds. ```sh # opkg opkg install ./luci-app-argon-config_*.ipk opkg install ./luci-theme-argon_*.ipk # APK v3 apk add --allow-untrusted ./luci-app-argon-config-*.apk apk add --allow-untrusted ./luci-theme-argon-*.apk ``` The first command replaces the old plugin with the empty migration package. The second installs the integrated theme and restores your settings. Continue configuring it under **System → Argon Config**.
## Customize Open **System → Argon Config** for login layouts, colors, glass effects, wallpapers and branding. The header's appearance button switches between **Light mode**, **Dark mode** and **Follow system**; the choice also applies to the login page. Local image and video backgrounds are supported, along with Bing, Unsplash and Wallhaven wallpapers. Unsplash requires an API access key, which is retained when you switch providers. On the first visit with an empty wallpaper cache, the page shows a local background while the router fetches the online image URL for subsequent visits. Browser icons and login logos accept PNG files, 16–1024 pixels per side, up to 1 MiB; browser icons must be square. On upgrade, an old shared key is migrated to `unsplash_api_key` when the configured source is Unsplash or an Unsplash collection. Otherwise the old value is kept locally as `legacy_wallpaper_api_key`. Confirm which service issued it before re-entering it. Tagged Wallhaven sources configured through UCI use `wallhaven_api_key`. Under **Theme updates**, check the latest stable release, read its release notes and download the package matching your firmware's package manager. When a newer version is available, choose **Update now** and confirm to install the theme using the firmware’s native APK or OPKG package manager, preserving your Argon configuration. The page shows download, verification and installation status plus installation logs, and resumes monitoring after a page refresh. Reload the page after installation. The updater downloads and verifies the theme and matching packages for your existing Argon translations before installing them. It also installs the configured LuCI language when that translation is available. Automatic installation requires matching release packages and SHA256 digests and does not downgrade the theme. If verified metadata is missing for an existing translation, update the theme and language packages manually from the same release. Translations bundled into a firmware's theme package, such as KWRT's Chinese catalog, are preserved during the first upgrade to official packages, including upgrades started by an older updater. A separately installed language package can then take ownership of the catalog. When building firmware, stop including the old standalone `luci-app-argon-config` plugin alongside the theme: its files conflict with the integrated settings. See [Build with OpenWrt](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#build-with-openwrt) for existing build scripts. ## Screenshots Light and dark views of the overview and both login layouts, on desktop and mobile. ![Light mode: desktop overview, classic and centered login](Screenshots/preview-light.png) ![Mobile light mode: classic login, centered login and overview](Screenshots/mobile-light.png) ![Dark mode: desktop overview, classic and centered login](Screenshots/preview-dark.png) ![Mobile dark mode: classic login, centered login and overview](Screenshots/mobile-dark.png) ## Contributors Made with [contrib.rocks](https://contrib.rocks). ## Development See the [development guide](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for source builds, LESS, templates, icons and checks.
